crossRefs.note: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I…
He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

translations.web: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
translations.bsb: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
translations.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
translations.asv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose; seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
